owner_constraint: Owner laptop and Windows runner are offline; do not start self-hosted UE4/Windows jobs or manual packaging.
objective: Keep P1C01 and whole-game asset production moving through source-only preparation, deterministic receipts, cheap hosted/static validation and batchable artifacts that can be promoted when the runner returns.
source_only_allowed_now: Python and PowerShell prep tooling that does not invoke Unreal
asset manifests, SHA256 receipt reuse and candidate ranking
FBX/PNG/TGA/ORM preparation scripts and static regressions
P1C01 placement, import and material mapping manifests
28-region source queue metadata without runtime activation
PR body/comment updates that do not push runtime changes
blocked_until_runner_available: UE4 editor import commandlets on self-hosted Windows

ci_policy.reason: Current pull_request workflows include self-hosted Windows jobs for PBR/runtime paths; opening or updating PRs can queue work the owner explicitly forbade.
ci_policy.safe_branch_rule: Create source-only branches from latest develop and keep them unmerged/unopened until filters are confirmed or the runner is intentionally available.
ci_policy.batching_rule: Accumulate related source-only work into one branch/commit set; avoid micro-commits that create superseded checks.
ci_policy.reuse_rule: Reuse unchanged SHA256 receipts and previous successful tests; rerun only tests affected by modified files.

license_policy.private_home_use_note: The owner has declared the game personal/home-use and not for publication or sale.
license_policy.reduced_admin_rule: Record a simple first-use source/right-to-use receipt for new external assets; do not block production with repeated license review for unchanged approved sources.
license_policy.nonwaivable_rule: Do not bypass access controls, copyright restrictions or executable-payload trust checks.

p1c01_priority_order: Bag End exterior/interior source pack readiness
Hobbiton and Bagshot Row placement/material manifests
Party Field, road, mill, water, bridge and garden manifests
living Shire schedules, dialogue metadata, ambience and Arabic subtitle/UI source prep
incremental import batch manifest for the first runner return
evidence_boundary: This file enables faster source production only. It does not claim imported assets, PIE, Windows package, device performance, visual acceptance or Gate 6/7 completion.
